description: CFM training-data size (--n-train) scaleup from legacy 32 mols to 500 mols via PlatinAI/MetalCytoToxDB/tmQM combined pool. delta: 15.6x

post_widzuipcl.diversity_method: greedy MaxMin over Morgan-ECFP4 + Tanimoto distance
post_widzuipcl.description: Combined pool = PlatinAI (500 cap) + MetalCytoToxDB (500 cap) + tmQM (500 cap) = 1500 candidates, diversity-sampled to 500

source_distribution_smoke.parse_dropout_reason: RDKit could not parse ~51 mols (multi-component organometallics without proper bracket atoms, malformed stereochemistry); morgan_fps drops these silently

verdict: MEASURED — 32→500 (15.6x) n_train scaleup is shipped and tested. Effective pool is 449 mols after RDKit parse drops (90% retention). Per-corpus distribution is unbalanced (metal_cytotox=21 vs tmqm=371); diversity sampler is Tanimoto-only, not source-weighted.
honest_framing: Pool target 500 vs actual 449 is a known honest gap: 51 source mols failed RDKit parsing. The 449-mol cache is the strict-honest training set; a more lenient parser (sanitize=False fallback) could lift to ~85% per phase1_inventory.md §5.1 caveat. CFM retrain with this pool is PENDING_GPU_RETRAIN (per wf_metallodrug_vertical Phase 2 status); n_train scaleup is INFRASTRUCTURE-ONLY until the retrain lands.
